description: Cross-venue perp basis and funding-spread scan across Binance, OKX, Bybit and Hyperliquid public data. Returns per-venue perp mark vs spot basis in bps plus pairwise ANNUALIZED funding deltas (Hyperliquid settles hourly, CEXes 8h, so raw rates are not comparable). Analysis over public reads — no sizing, no order, never signs.

coin.description: Base asset, e.g. BTC or ETH

quote.description: Quote asset for the CEX legs (default: USDT)

name: cex_basis_scan
